data.assessment: In this quiet period every order was delivered on time (82.6 of 82.6), with 0.0 late and 0.0 unfinished, and customer waits were short (p95_wait_s 71.4, max_wait_s 102). The main goal is therefore saturated: no rule change can raise on_time_deliveries by the required 1.0, so none could pass the improvement gate. The only visible friction is 18.0 hold-limit overstays, almost all penalised on Company C (sanction 18.6, utility 10.0 vs 26–28 for A and B). Under K1 fairness is not part of the KPI and is only a tie-breaker, and it cannot justify a change with no KPI gain, so I propose no amendments this period.
